visualReview.notes: All17 portable and17 shared current frames inspected, followed by full-resolution perforated façade, entrance, dugout, lattice and placement views. Final revisions restore continuous concourse slabs, blue-white irregular seating mosaic, properly positioned dugouts and unobscured field surface. Closeup verifies genuine circular alpha-cutout holes with visible structure through them; canonical surface is embedded for portable rendering. 2026-10-01 filtering follow-up: inspected every newly rendered portable frame and the corresponding shared views. Mipmapped fractional coverage removes the repeating interference bands while retaining near apertures and visible structure behind the panels. No changed geometry, silhouette or panel orientation was observed.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: 2026-10-01: inspected all current reflected shared frames, full-size near and intermediate facade views, all four overview directions, interiors and north-up placement. Fractional alpha coverage uses trilinear filtering and standard blending, matching the portable GLB. Near holes remain visible; distant panels retain average openness without the prior moire bands or the grain observed in a rejected stochastic-coverage experiment. Canonical surfaces are acquired once and unloaded with zero live model geometries. Conventional transparent layer sorting remains a renderer limitation; no new layer-order defect was visible in these views.
